# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `librepass` MCP server pointing at LibrePass's hosted endpoint (`https://librepass.co/mcp/`).
- No authentication; all tools are read-only.
- Logo: references `https://librepass.co/brand/logo-512.png` by URL; the image could not be downloaded when this plugin was added.
